summary: Hawkins County, Tennessee tower built in 1937 as the Flat Gap tower and later renamed Mooresburg; the newest condition report found dates from 2008.

events.note: NHLR build year; originally known as the Flat Gap tower, later renamed Mooresburg
Visit report by Jeff Flanary, April 20, 2008: cab rusty, roof needs work, most glass intact
Registered March 14, 2014 as US 990, TN 10; nominated by Ron Stafford

evidence.supports: built 1937, originally the Flat Gap tower
evidence.quote: This tower was built in 1937 and originally known as the Flat Gap tower.
Its name was later changed to Mooresburg.

evidence.supports: administered by Tennessee Division of Forestry
rusty cab, roof needs work, most glass intact, stairs ok, bottom run removed
evidence.quote: Cab is rusty, roof needs work, most glass intact, stairs look ok, bottom run has been removed.

evidence.supports: two other towers at site, antennas, solar panel
evidence.quote: Two other towers at this site, antennas all over the tower itself as well as a small solar panel.

corrections.why: Forest Lookouts lists Clinch Mountain as a separate tower in Hancock County, not this Hawkins County tower, so the alias does not describe this lookout. Removed from the story and its evidence quotes; source 3 is kept only as the record of this correction.
The NHLR entry gives no height, and no other page read gives 24.4 m (80 ft) for this tower. No height appears in the facts or the story.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one substantive NHLR page (2008 visit, 2014 registration) plus a Forest Lookouts header. No condition report after 2008, so current standing is unverified. The 24.4 m height has no source in the pages read and is not carried in the facts or the story. The Clinch Mountain alias is removed from the story and evidence; Forest Lookouts lists that name for a separate Hancock County tower. The 2008 visit staffing question reads No, but that quote breaks across lines, so staffing is left out of facts and the story. One web search found a 78-foot radio structure in Mooresburg registered to WJDT FM; it is not this lookout and was not used. Access, design and current condition are unknown.
